Activities on Ha Long cruise will bring visitors the most memorable experiences, when traveling on a cruise, visitors not only admire the beautiful scenery of the bay but also participate in entertainment activities. So let’s go through the activities on the cruise with Vietlook right below.

Activities On Ha Long Cruise Supported By Vietlook Travel

A short paragraph, the recreational activities that can be experienced during a cruise trip in Ha Long Bay that customers can enjoy.

Afternoon tea party

When on the cruise in the afternoon, you will welcome the sunset right from the deck and enjoy a cup of tea, there is nothing more interesting than that, on a 5-star Ha Long cruise.

This is one of the experiences for those who love to admire the natural scenery, and enjoy drinks such as cocktails or wine… together chatting about stories of watching the sea and islands.

Cooking class

An experience chosen by many tourists, especially those from abroad, who want to learn how to prepare Vietnamese dishes, on the cruise you can learn to make Asian and European dishes. This is a great experience for those who love cuisine and want to explore more about Vietnamese culture and cuisine.

Live music

When joining the Ha Long cruise, you will enjoy the fun live music space right on the cruise, young music, country music or jazz music will help visitors have the most relaxing moments during their vacation.

Squid fishing

Participating in squid fishing in Ha Long Bay is one of the experiences chosen by many tourists, while fishing for squid, visitors can admire the scenery of the bay, you will fish squid with the locals, there is nothing more interesting than catching fresh squid yourself, you can bring it back and have the chef prepare it and enjoy it right on the cruise, there is nothing more interesting.

Karaoke

Right on the cruise will bring visitors exciting feelings, especially tourists who go on Ha Long tours in large groups, or companies, this is the opportunity for you to sing together happily.

Play Poker

This is a popular entertainment game right on the Ha Long cruise, which will bring tourists a challenging and exciting night on the Ha Long cruise.

Enjoy wine and Cigar

This is one of the high-class wines, whiskey, rum, cognac or attractive cigars. If you want to choose the types of wine, you can ask the cruise staff for advice on more premium wines that suit your taste.

Play Golf

Right on the 5, 6 star cruise, there are golf services, for tourists who love sports, with modern professional golf courses, tourists can play golf while relaxing with the interesting sea and island scenery.

Swimming pool/ Jacuzzi

Currently, Ha Long cruises all have swimming pools for tourists to relax in the cool water, watching the scenery, this is one of the most relaxing experiences, dispelling the stuffiness of the bustling city, blending with the space of the vast sea and islands.

Gym

For those who regularly exercise, when going on a Ha Long cruise tour, you will participate in exercising right on the cruise, which is not only good for your health but also an opportunity for tourists to regain their shape after a long vacation.

Spa

There are Sapa services right on the cruise, with professional therapies such as massage, sauna, herbal bath, skin care, exfoliation… performed by professional experts to bring customers the most relaxing moments.

Take photos by flycam

Chosen by many tourists, especially those who love virtual life, from flycam tourists can save the most beautiful moments as souvenirs of their tour, right on the Ha Long cruise.

Early morning Tai Chi/Yoga/Vovinam practice

You can practice early in the morning in the cool weather on the sea and improve your health when participating in Tai Chi, Yoga or Vovinam…

Experience A Five Star Cruise Tour In Ha Long

It can be said that a trip on a 5-star Ha Long Bay cruise not only brings visitors exciting feelings when watching the scenery and when the boat glides through the famous landscapes, the undulating waves, but also experience the exciting games that will bring visitors the most unforgettable vacation.
